pr_title: Redirect on project after issue created
pr_body:

If user create an issue with button in project view, after issue is created the user is redirect to project view.

issue_context.title: New Issue Button on Project Page: redirect back to project after issue creation
issue_context.body:
a followup would be: after issue creation was sucessfull, redirect back to project

_Originally posted by @6543 in https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/issues/17001#issuecomment-916833055_

followup of #14824 ...

review_comments: It seems this is unnecessary? The POST requests will also request the current URL. So that the query strings are still there.
The issue edit form's `action` is filled by `{{.Link}}`, without query string. So this parameter is necessary.
